title: I don't like this soup, Dad.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I don't like this soup, Dad.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But you used to like it a lot.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Well, it's too salty for me now.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Try eating it together with some bread.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Does bread really make it less salty?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: I'm not sure, but it's worth a try.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Okay, it tastes a little better now.
